verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents one concrete bulk operation of its own: a single number-port request can take up to 1000 numbers (50 in Canada), entered comma-separated or as ranges. It also claims number management "at scale". Beyond porting, the evidence shows no bulk assign, reassign, delete or settings changes, and no programmatic bulk API for Voice items. Missing for 10: bulk user/number assignment and license operations, bulk edits to ring groups or auto attendants, a programmatic or API-driven bulk interface, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Landline or VoIP—Enter up to 1000 phone numbers (50 in Canada), separated by commas. For a number range, enter a starting and ending number separated by a hyphen.
your organization gets a simple way to deploy and manage phone numbers at scale.
Multiple ports can be active at the same time.
